name: The Girl in Cedar Falls
source:
When Cedar Falls’ resident goth, Lucy Streza, turned up at the boys’ basketball practice, heads turned. Stu Caffrey, on a dare, asked her out – only to be met with a chillingly strange response. 

As Lucy’s behavior grew more erratic and a friend fell mysteriously ill, Stu began to suspect her secret was far darker than anyone imagined.

[From [url=https://jasonhubbard.itch.io/the-girl-in-cedar-falls]Itch.io[/url]]
